metadata.description: Wil's Claude Code operating stack: the engine (build, review, audit, plan, infra), the stack pipeline, the ledger, user walkthroughs, UI-glitch forensics, Codex delegation, and manual-only playbooks.

plugins.name: agent-loops
plugins.description: Foundation: the project-agnostic operating manual for autonomous agent work — the four-station loop, machine-checkable /goal conditions, adversarial verify panels, context budgeting, overnight-lane provisioning, the harvest retro, and the self-improving retro station. The brain the engine modes rest on.

plugins.name: engine
plugins.description: The autonomous engine. `engine` (/engine): design a gate that can prove a task done and can fail, then build and self-verify until green. Siblings: `engine-review` (the adversarial review panel), `engine-audit` (findings as the product), `engine-planning` (a machine-checkable plan), `engine-infra` (migrations and deploys behind a guardrail harness), and `goal` (set or check the run's DONE condition).

plugins.name: diagnose-ui-glitch
plugins.description: Video-forensic UI bug diagnosis: drives Chrome to record a .webm of an interaction, finds the first frame where behavior diverges from what should happen, diagnoses the cause with time-aligned DevTools signals (console, network, computed style, trace), proposes a fix, and re-records to prove the glitch is gone. For motion/timing defects a screenshot cannot capture. Bundles a Playwright capture harness and an ffmpeg frame extractor.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: [ARCHIVED — csa-new only] Governor/Liaison split for multi-lane agent phases: `govern` opens the policy-and-sequencing authority (read-only inspection, docs-only writes, receipt audits); `liaison` runs one lane's mechanics (worktrees, build dispatch, gates, commits, PRs) and can never merge to main. Extracted verbatim from csa-new 2026-07-29; repo-specific paths and policies need adapting for other projects.

plugins.name: stack
plugins.description: The mega skill — one entry point (/stack <task>) that conducts the full pipeline: recall, git-discipline lanes, ledger, shaping/bug-replication, the engine+delegate execution machine, and the quality tripod, sealed by verification. Ships the doctrine alongside the conductor skill.

plugins.name: user-walkthrough
plugins.description: The Playwright leg of the quality tripod: drive the running app like a real user — every workflow end-to-end, then the edge-case battery (empty states, invalid input, double-actions, refresh mid-flow, small viewport). Findings and screenshots to the ledger; green unit tests are not this.

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: Working-memory discipline for any multi-phase task: keep a <task>-progress.md ledger as the source of truth, update it before every commit, /compact only at phase boundaries, resume via read-ledger → next phase → gates → commit → update. Distilled from the engine so it composes with any execution mode.

plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate a tightly specified implementation slice to the Codex CLI (newest GPT) — spec, execute in a sandbox, review the diff, run the gate. Includes a read-only advisor mode for second opinions.

plugins.name: playbooks
plugins.description: Six manual-only review and repair playbooks: spec-review, spec-verify, bug-hunt, bug-fix, architecture-doc, vibe-audit. They never auto-trigger, so they cost no context until you call one by name.
